beer.beer_description:
An exuberant blend of colour, flavours and aromas, Red IPA is our signature beer. Designed and first created in Simon’s garage back in 2012.

Everyone who tries it, loves it. The colour of a kaka’s wing. Where tart ruby grapefruit meets berries and passionfruit. A comforting toasty malt on the palate, rounded off with a satisfying, sustained finish.
